preconditions.expression: all(c in {'A', 'C', 'G', 'T', '?'} for c in s)

The length of the genome string s must exactly match the given integer n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '===' or (all(c in {'A', 'C', 'G', 'T'} for c in stdout) and len(stdout) == n and all(stdout.count(c) == n // 4 for c in {'A', 'C', 'G', 'T'}) and all(stdout[i] == s[i] or s[i] == '?' for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: If a valid decoding exists, stdout is a string of length n with no '?' characters, where each of 'A', 'C', 'G', 'T' appears exactly n//4 times and is derived from s by replacing only '?' characters. Otherwise, stdout is '==='.
